4.name: Guardian's Vow
4.desc: While you live above 25% HP, your other party members take 15% less damage and the redirected portion is dealt to you.

13.name: Bloodrage
13.desc: Your attack grows as your HP drops (up to +40% at 10% HP), but healing you receive is halved.

26.name: Iaido Stance
26.desc: Your first action each battle deals double damage and cannot miss.

30.name: Crowd Favorite
30.desc: Arena win streaks grant permanent attack and richer arena loot rolls.

33.name: Aegis Ward
33.desc: While you live, the whole party takes less physical AND magical damage, scaled by your current HP (a full-HP Guardian wards 25%). Multiple Guardians stack, up to 50%.

40.name: Thick Hide
40.desc: Elemental weaknesses against you are capped at x1.5 instead of x2, and cold cannot harm you.

22.name: Consecration
22.desc: Sacred damage you deal also heals you for 20% of the damage.

38.name: Contractor
38.desc: You earn a gold bounty for each enemy you defeat, and combat jobs pay you more.

32.name: Field Marshal
32.desc: While you live, all allies gain +10% hit; troops you recruit cost less and desert less.

5.name: Grapple Chain
5.desc: Consecutive basic attacks on the same enemy build a Pin; at 3 the enemy is stunned. Everything you summon comes through with +30% health and +20% attack and magic.

11.name: Chi Flow
11.desc: Every 3rd action refunds its AP and grants a surge of extra energy.

15.name: Ascetic
15.desc: Hunger and sleep drain 30% slower and resting restores more energy.

16.name: Spellshot
16.desc: With a firearm in hand you deal +25% damage and every action returns a little mana. A spell aimed at one enemy is fired out of the barrel and spends a round, so an empty magazine refuses it; reloading hands back a fifth of your maximum mana.

17.name: Footwork
17.desc: High evasion lets you slip punches; each dodge builds a Combo stack (max 5) that adds +8% damage per stack to your next hit.

18.name: Kayfabe
18.desc: You play to the crowd, opening every battle with a surge of bonus AP.

14.name: Freerunner
14.desc: Your agility is greatly heightened (+30%), so you act sooner, and you shrug off fall damage.

2.name: Brewmistress
2.desc: Your potions come out one quality tier higher and you can brew battle hexes.

10.name: Attunement
10.desc: At battle start you attune to the weather, gaining +25% to the matching element.

12.name: Runesmith
12.desc: You can imbue equipment with an extra affix at no material cost once per item.

19.name: Combustion
19.desc: Your fire deals +30% damage and you are immune to Burn.

20.name: Deep Freeze
20.desc: Your ice deals +30% damage and slows the enemies it strikes.

27.name: Arcane Mastery
27.desc: All your spell MP costs are reduced by 20%.

36.name: Mirror Image
36.desc: You start each battle with decoy images that absorb the first hits aimed at you.

39.name: Enlightened
39.desc: You gain bonus skill-training progress and read extra lore from every book.

34.name: Spell Edge
34.desc: Your basic attacks carry the element of the last spell you cast.

37.name: War Caster
37.desc: You cast from the front line without penalty and spells draw on AP when your MP runs dry.

23.name: Pact
23.desc: You can burn your own HP as spell fuel and dark-faction standing strengthens your curses.

31.name: Grave Harvest
31.desc: Every enemy that dies leaves a soul charge that fuels your summons.

8.name: Devotee
8.desc: During night hours you deal +15% damage and take 10% less; your trial penalties are reduced. You copy any skill out of a grimoire or a skill book whatever your level, but the Skill Master teaches you nothing.

7.name: Sanguine
7.desc: You steal 30% of melee damage as HP, but sunlight burns you and you feed instead of eating.

62.name: Desperation
62.desc: The less gold you carry, the higher your critical and evasion; you fear nothing.

21.name: Ambush
21.desc: You have a high critical rate and deal +25% damage to enemies still at full HP.

35.name: Songweaver
35.desc: Each turn a rotating song pulses a buff to the whole party.

3.name: Benediction
3.desc: While you live, the party heals a little at the end of every turn.

25.name: Divine Favor
25.desc: Overhealing you deliver is converted into a protective barrier rather than wasted.

59.name: Sermon
59.desc: You deal bonus Sacred damage to cursed foes and bless allies with lingering regen.

29.name: Foresight
29.desc: You foresee each enemy's next action, shown on the battle HUD.

9.name: Triage
9.desc: Healing an ally below 25% HP also grants them an adrenaline attack boost.

41.name: Physician
41.desc: Your limb and organ injuries heal faster and you can perform field surgery.

51.name: Bedside Manner
51.desc: Every potion and healing item you use restores 30% more.

61.name: Divine Blood
61.desc: You are immune to instant death; once per battle a lethal hit revives you at 30% HP.

42.name: Method
42.desc: Your crafting and alchemy yield an extra output and you can analyze unknown items.

48.name: Tenure
48.desc: You learn fast: +25% battle experience, and read full bestiary entries at once.

49.name: Insight
49.desc: Your composure makes you immune to fear, confusion and charm; you also read enemy morale and NPC minds.

50.name: Excavator
50.desc: Your digging and treasure rolls improve and artifacts are more likely identified.

53.name: Kinematics
53.desc: Your thunder and physical crits splash based on enemy speed and your ship burns less fuel.

58.name: Forecaster
58.desc: You always foresee current and upcoming weather and its effect on crops and bees.

46.name: Press Pass
46.desc: You cover every fight for a small gold scoop per enemy defeated, and NPCs reveal more to you.

54.name: Gearhead
54.desc: Vehicle repairs cost half and dismantling furniture returns full materials. Nothing you do is magic: your mana never rises above the ten you started with.

24.name: Marksman
24.desc: Your bow and gun attacks deal +25% damage and never suffer the melee-range penalty.

28.name: Pathfinder
28.desc: You spot danger early: battles you enter are far more likely to be a preemptive strike, and enemies rarely ambush you.

52.name: Forager
52.desc: You passively gather wild food and materials and harvest more from plants and spoils.

56.name: Green Thumb
56.desc: Your crops grow 25% faster and yield more, and animals mature and produce faster.

57.name: Timberman
57.desc: You gather extra wood and swing axes with bonus damage and a chance to fell large foes.

43.name: Fireproof
43.desc: You are immune to Burn and fire damage and can put out environmental blazes.

47.name: Builder
47.desc: Your building is free-form, crafting costs less material and structures can be reinforced.

45.name: Gourmet
45.desc: Your cooking gives more nutrition, grants a well-fed buff and never causes overeating.

1.name: Jack of All Trades
1.desc: You get a flat bonus to every job, never hard-fail a stat check and learn a random skill on level up.

6.name: Capital
6.desc: Markets and loans favor you, shops you run produce faster, and you buy at a discount.

44.name: Law
44.desc: You accrue less bounty, get trial leniency and can arrest weakened humanoid foes.

55.name: Merchant
55.desc: You buy cheaper and sell dearer everywhere, and daily stock restocks with better items.

60.name: Showtime
60.desc: You earn gold and goodwill performing, and the party gains morale after any minigame win.

66.name: Augmented
66.desc: You are immune to poison, disease and bleed, run on power instead of hunger, and carry a regenerating energy shield.

63.name: Feral
63.desc: Your natural weapons hit hard, you regenerate quickly and you intimidate weak foes on sight.

64.name: Shapeshift
64.desc: You stay disguised so enemies target you last, and you copy a defeated foe's skill.

65.name: Apex
65.desc: You feed on defeated enemies to heal and grow stronger with each kill.

202.name: Gun-Fu
202.desc: While wielding a gun, projectile weapon or bow, every Martial Arts skill you use is followed by a free normal attack on the same enemy.

43.name: Dual Grip
43.desc: You handle a weapon in each hand without the off-hand penalty.

74.name: Feel Nothing
74.desc: Pain never staggers you: wounds do not reduce your accuracy or speed.

41.name: Total Recall
41.desc: You remember every enemy you have fought, revealing their resistances on sight.

152.name: Riposte
152.desc: When a single enemy faces you alone, you answer its misses with a counter.

155.name: Bulwark
155.desc: A raised shield also protects the ally standing beside you.

156.name: First Blood
156.desc: Your opening strike of a battle always critically hits an unaware foe.

31.name: Pain Feeds
31.desc: Damage you take charges your energy instead of only hurting you.

190.name: Mana Wellspring
190.desc: Your magic reserves refill on their own between battles.

195.name: Moonchange
195.desc: Under a full moon you shift form and fight with a beast's strength.

99.name: Ill Fate
99.desc: Misfortune follows you, but curses cast at you rebound on their caster.

log.chamberedMana: {actor} draws mana back out of the chamber.
log.chamberedReload: {actor} loads the chamber and draws the mana back.
